title: Staff caller verification with a partial PIN
summary: Staff can now confirm who is calling by asking for two digits of the caller's phone verification PIN. Staff never see any PIN digit.
changes: Add a Callers page for staff, volunteers and students to find the person on the phone.
The system asks for two random PIN digits and checks what the caller says.
Three wrong attempts pause checking for that caller for 15 minutes.
Every check is recorded in the audit log without any PIN digits.
version_rationale: Patch: adds a staff page on top of the 0.49.0 PIN, with no data change.
validation: New feature test for finding callers, correct and wrong digits, lockout, audit entries and access rules.
Navigation, PIN, authorisation and translation tests.
known_limitations: Editing a caller's details after verification and call logs follow in the next releases. Callers without a PIN need the usual identity checks.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No data changes.
provenance: Milestone v0.49.3 Beta, issue #477 under epic #475, pull request #603.
